Outcome_variable.extract_value: life satisfaction, positive affect, negative affect
Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] The postal questionnaire included questions concerning PLO: life satisfaction (yes/no), feeling needed (yes/no), having plans for the future (yes/no), having zest for life (yes/no), feeling depressed (seldom or never/sometimes/often or always) and suffering from loneliness (seldom or never/sometimes/often or always).
Outcome_variable.warning: The paper reports a composite 'PLO total score' from these items. 'Life satisfaction' is explicit. 'Feeling depressed' and 'suffering from loneliness' map to negative affect. 'Feeling needed', 'having plans for the future', and 'having zest for life' map to positive affect.
